$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (automation-integration-regression-tests). Declares integration_test_case (a known input with its expected output for a mapping or a synchronization) and integration_test_run (one suite run: counts and, per failed case, the paths that differ). See openspec/changes/automation-integration-regression-tests/design.md D1 and D3. Seeds two cases for the seeded lowercase-keys mapping; a run seeds nothing, it is history.

integration_test_case.title: Integration test case
integration_test_case.summary: A known input and the output a mapping or synchronization must produce for it
integration_test_case.description: A regression test case. A suite run feeds the input through its subject and compares the result with the expected output, ignoring the listed paths. See openspec/changes/automation-integration-regression-tests/specs/integration-regression-tests/spec.md REQ-IRT-001.

name.title: Name
name.description: What the case checks, in a few words.

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: Whether the case tests a mapping or a synchronization.

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: The uuid or slug of the mapping or synchronization under test.

input.title: Input
input.description: The object fed to the subject.

expectedOutput.title: Expected output
expectedOutput.description: The output the subject must produce for the input.

ignoredPaths.title: Ignored paths
ignoredPaths.description: Dot paths left out of the comparison, such as a generated timestamp.

x-openregister-seed.name: Lowercase keys gives no output without rules
x-openregister-seed.description: The seeded mapping has no rules yet, so it maps any input to an empty object. Update the expected output when you add rules.

x-openregister-seed.name: Lowercase keys ignores dateModified
x-openregister-seed.description: Shows an ignored path: a generated timestamp in the expected output does not fail the case.

integration_test_run.title: Integration test run
integration_test_run.summary: One run of the test cases of a mapping or synchronization
integration_test_run.description: A suite run record: the counts and, per failed case, the paths whose values differ. Written once per run; nothing else is written by a run. See REQ-IRT-003.

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: Whether the run tested a mapping or a synchronization.

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: The uuid or slug of the mapping or synchronization that ran.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Number of cases whose output matched.

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: Number of cases whose output differed or that could not run.

failures.title: Failures
failures.description: Per failed case: its id, its name, the differing paths with the expected and actual value, or the error that stopped it.

runBy.title: Run by
runBy.description: The user who started the run.
